title: earth/smoke/adjusted.json: the hour's smoke model (CAMS) adjusted to the monitors near it (session 8, part 125), on the grid of the smoke layer's now file. An estimate: never the Now page's big number, never an hour (invariant 3). History, downloads and the connector keep the model alone.

at.description: The model's time: the now file's `at`.

box_at.description: The regional box's hour inside the global grid: the now file's `box_at`, when it has one.

grid.description: The now file's grid: values row by row from lat0 northwards, each row from lon0 eastwards.

values.description: Whole µg/m³ per cell; null where the model has none. nlat times nlon of them.

method.description: For each monitor used: r = log((measured + offset) / (model at its place + offset)), the ratio held to `ratio`. At each cell: the weighted mean of r over the monitors within radius_km, times the coverage, smoothed over smooth_km; adjusted = model times e to that power.

used.description: Each monitor used, [lat, lon] to 2 decimals (about 1 km).

why.description: In words: which readings were left out, how many, and why.

left_out.description: Monitors not used, by why, each counted once, in this order: DOE's 24-hour index (doe_index) or another unit (not_pm25); over 3 hours old (late); exactly 0 (zero); marked suspect; outside the model's grid (no_model).
